nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the elderly father shown in <Picture 1>, with swept-back silver hair, a short gray beard, a weathered face, a loose blue-gray linen shirt with rolled sleeves, dark loose trousers, and tan slippers.
<Subject 2> is the modest apartment living room shown in <Picture 2>, with a wooden table and chair beside a large window overlooking a city at dusk.
<Subject 3> is the dark-screen smartphone with metallic edges shown in <Picture 3>.

summary:
[reference generation] Create a 7-second live-action video using <Subject 1>, <Subject 2>, and <Subject 3> as appearance and environment references.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> ([Shot 1]): fully_preserved - Preserve the father's facial features, silver hair, short beard, body type, and clothing.
<Subject 2> ([Shot 1]): fully_preserved - Preserve the living-room layout, window, table, chair, and dusk lighting.
<Subject 3> ([Shot 1]): fully_preserved - Preserve the smartphone's dark screen, metallic edges, shape, and proportions.

detailed_description:
The target video is a restrained live-action drama with natural dusk light from the window, warm practical room light, realistic skin and fabric texture, and quiet observational pacing. The composition begins in a medium close shot of the father seated beside the wooden table, with the phone resting within reach. <Subject 1> has a low, slightly raspy older male Mandarin voice, measured and clear, with the hesitant cadence of an ordinary voice message to his daughter; this is speaker (S1). [Shot 1] The father looks at <Subject 3>, presses the recording control, and begins speaking. <Subject 1> (S1) says softly: <d>[Chinese] 喂……</d> His voice trails off naturally. He pauses, releases the control, cancels the recording, and slowly lifts his eyes toward the window. The camera holds steady as the room remains still around him. The phone stays on the table, and the father's clothing, seated position, and direction of gaze remain consistent throughout the shot.

overall_soundscape:
A faint clock tick and quiet apartment room tone sit beneath the distant city ambience. The phone makes a soft handling sound as the father presses and releases its recording control.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
